mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM retail_price_ref_lines WHERE source_id = #{sourceId}

SELECT id, source_id, barcode, product_name, purchase_price_tax, retail_price, created_at FROM retail_price_ref_lines
ORDER BY barcode ASC, id ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT id, source_id, barcode, product_name, purchase_price_tax, retail_price, created_at FROM retail_price_ref_lines
ORDER BY barcode ASC, id ASC

SELECT l.id, l.source_id AS sourceId, l.barcode, l.product_name AS productName, l.purchase_price_tax AS purchasePriceTax, l.retail_price AS retailPrice, l.created_at AS createdAt FROM retail_price_ref_lines l INNER JOIN retail_price_sources s ON s.id = l.source_id AND s.active = 1 ORDER BY s.priority ASC, s.id ASC, l.barcode ASC
